prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: eight cover illustrations for a software skills library, supplied as a precisely aligned contact sheet.

Create a 3:2 landscape image divided into EXACTLY four equal columns and two equal rows, with no gutters, no gaps, no outer margins, no rounded corners and no visible grid strokes. Each of the eight cells is a complete 3:4 portrait illustration. The artwork in each cell stops precisely at that cell's edge. No object crosses into a neighboring cell. I will crop the sheet into eight separate cover illustrations.

These are authored editorial covers for a calm, thoughtful desktop application called Factory, not logos or app icons. Make them feel like a coherent collection of contemporary small-press printed editions. Full-bleed reductive woodcut and cut-paper compositions, convincing subtle ink-on-paper texture, bold silhouettes, finely considered negative space. Each cover has a large, distinctive composition that remains identifiable when small, not a tiny central symbol surrounded by empty space. No lettering at all: the interface supplies all text.

Use river blue, deep blue-green, moss and olive, straw ochre, warm chalk, dark ink and a little muted brick red. Vary the dominant ground between the cells, including some dark covers and some light ones. They must feel like the same series without repeating the same composition.

Cell order, left to right, top row then bottom row:
1. Code review: two overlapping cut-paper architectural plans seen front-on, their aligned edges revealing a third precise shape where they meet. Deep river-blue ground, chalk and pale moss layers. A deliberate, discerning composition, no fake code.
2. Diagnosing bugs: a large branching network of chalk paths on a dense olive ground, one path visibly interrupted and picked out with a small brick-red fragment. The eye can follow the trace, a large cropped network, not a circuit-board icon.
3. Extended grilling: a sequence of concentric irregular carved arches, each opening revealing another, until a tiny warm-lit opening at the deepest point. Dark charcoal green ground and warm ochre cuts. The questioning goes deeper.
4. Frontend design: an asymmetric cut-paper architectural composition of windows, planes, an opening and a single curved shape, balanced as a finished print. Warm chalk ground, river blue, brick and ochre. No device mockup and no UI.
5. Requirements interview: two broad interwoven ribbons crossing and separating, leaving an open center in which a clear new shape emerges. Ochre ground, chalk and deep moss ribbons. No chat bubbles.
6. Test-driven development: three interlocking circular paths, each with a distinct start and return, one dark, one chalk, one restrained brick, in a carefully balanced continuous composition. Pale moss ground. No arrows, checkmarks or test-tube icons.
7. Verify completion: a series of staggered dark geometric layers passing through one exactly aligned opening into a clean, continuous shape. Chalk ground with river-blue ink and an ochre area. No ticks, medals or badges.
8. Unassigned personal skill cover: a single large folded page becoming an architectural plane, cropped as a confident abstract print. Deep warm green and chalk. This is the understated fallback for a custom or imported skill, not an extra feature.

No words, letters, numbers, labels, symbols, logos, watermarks, photographs of books, bookshelves, drop shadows, glossy gradients, cartoons, people, magnifying-glass icons, decorative badges or interface chrome.
